tools.description: Start here for a keyword or cross-company search, or for a company's newest openings. For every opening of one company use list_company_jobs; for the full text use get_job.
When you know an employer's name but not its SmartRecruiters identifier.

To enumerate a company's openings, e.g. from a pasted careers.smartrecruiters.com/<company> or api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/<company>/postings URL. Pass next_cursor back as cursor until it is null; use get_job for a posting's full text and salary.
After search_jobs or company_jobs, with a card's url. Any pasted ziprecruiter.com /c/.../Job/... URL with a jid works.

For a pasted posting URL in any SmartRecruiters shape (jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<company>/<id>-<slug>, /ni/<company>/<uuid>, /oneclick-ui/company/<company>/publication/<uuid>, www.smartrecruiters.com/<company>/<id>, api.smartrecruiters.com/v1/companies/<company>/postings/<id>), or a company and id from list_company_jobs or search_jobs.
After search_jobs, with the company slug from a card's company_url (e.g. YO-AI-Labs from /co/YO-AI-Labs/Jobs) and a city.
